title: #206 Studying in Other Countries
prompt: As part of education, students should spend a period of time studying and living in a different country to learn language and culture. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

promptSegments.text: As part of education, students should spend a period of time studying and living in a different country to learn language and culture.
To what extent do you agree or disagree?

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu rõ mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Bảo vệ quan điểm bằng 2 lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Sử dụng các dẫn chứng thực tế thuyết phục để củng cố luận điểm.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Studying in a different country helps students improve their language skills through daily use.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Studying in a different country helps students improve their language skills through daily use.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Living in a new country helps students understand different cultures and ways of life.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Living in a new country helps students understand different cultures and ways of life.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Studying abroad is not always the best way to learn about a new culture.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Studying abroad is not always the best way to learn about a new culture.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Moving to another country is not the only way to improve language skills.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Moving to another country is not the only way to improve language skills.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first point discusses how living in a foreign country helps students improve their language skills through daily immersion.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first point discusses how living in a foreign country helps students improve their language skills through daily immersion.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The second point explains that studying abroad helps students gain a deeper understanding of different cultures by interacting with local people.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The second point explains that studying abroad helps students gain a deeper understanding of different cultures by interacting with local people.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Studying abroad is not a guarantee of better language skills, as academic success relies more on the student's preparation and effort at home, and short visits are insufficient for real language growth.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Studying abroad is not a guarantee of better language skills, as academic success relies more on the student's preparation and effort at home, and short visits are insufficient for real language growth.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Living in a foreign country does not automatically teach deep cultural understanding because many students only interact with people in tourist areas, limiting their knowledge to surface-level customs.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Living in a foreign country does not automatically teach deep cultural understanding because many students only interact with people in tourist areas, limiting their knowledge to surface-level customs.

promptTraps.en: Do not answer only the first question while neglecting the second requirement; address both dimensions equally.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ trả lời câu hỏi đầu tiên mà bỏ quên yêu cầu thứ hai; cần giải quyết cả hai khía cạnh công bằng.

promptTraps.en: Do not merely rephrase the topic without stating a definitive personal position in both intro and conclusion.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ diễn đạt lại đề bài mà quên khẳng định rõ lập trường cá nhân ở cả mở bài và kết bài.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
